```sql
SELECT
  player_id,
  player_name,
  SUM(fg3m) AS fg3m,
  SUM(fg3a) AS fg3a,
  CAST(SUM(fg3m) AS REAL) / NULLIF(SUM(fg3a), 0) AS fg3_pct
FROM "nba_golden"."dev"."player_game_stats"
WHERE game_date >= '2017-01-01' AND game_date < '2018-01-01'
GROUP BY player_id, player_name
ORDER BY fg3m DESC
LIMIT 1;
```
